meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

copy.tagline: 将 OpenClaw 配置迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw configuration to NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are migrating from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2

howto.what: 当用户提到迁移时，Claude 会检测现有 OpenClaw 安装，读取配置，与用户讨论并逐步引导迁移到 NanoClaw v2，包括身份、频道凭证、定时任务等。
howto.when: 当用户说出“migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration”或“import from openclaw”时触发。

say.text: 我想从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw。
say.note: 开始检测 OpenClaw 安装并进入迁移流程。

say.text: 帮我导入 OpenClaw 的配置。
say.note: Claude 会读取配置并与你讨论迁移方案。
直接启动迁移，Claude 会引导每一步。

howto.what_en: Claude detects an existing OpenClaw installation, reads its config, discusses with the user, and guides the migration to NanoClaw v2 step by step, including identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", or "import from openclaw".

say_en.text: I want to migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw.

say_en.note: Claude reads config and discusses options.
